msd_fit = msd[start_idx:]

print(f"Linear fit results (using data from t={time_fit[0]:.2f} ps to t={time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps):")
print(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Å²/ps")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept:.6f} Å²")
print(f"R²: {r_value**2:.6f}")
print(f"Standard error: {std_err:.6f}")

# Calculate diffusion coefficient using Einstein relation: D = MSD / (6t)

plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Å²)')
plt.title('Mean Square Displacement vs Time with Linear Fit')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.savefig('msd_with_fit.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
